summary.claim: MetaAPO reduces the mismatch between offline preference data and the evolving policy: a meta-learner estimates where online sampling helps and gives per-sample weights. Online annotation cost drops by 42%.
summary.condition: Evaluated on AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard and MT-Bench.
summary.gap: (Inferred) The abstract names no base models or datasets, and no effect on safety alignment is reported.
